ns2:section.sectionText: Examinations will be held on Thursday evenings from 7:00-9:00 pm on September 15, October 13, and November 10, 2022. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment. This course-based tuition is non-refundable after the 10th day of class. You may add your name to the online waitlist at https://go.illinois.edu/mcb450_FA22_waitlist if the course is full.
